Meet Ash

The name in nearly every review

A lifelong waterman and Central Coast local who surfs, kitesurfs and snowboards. Ash co-founded propel.flights with Justin and has been on Fliteboards since 2019.

  • Level 3 Fliteboard service authorisation
  • ~20 minutes typical learning curve, by Ash’s count
  • Thousands of riders hosted
